purpose: ADR-022 #8: NeMo-RL v0.7.0 VLM GRPO on ONE GB10 (no official 1-GPU VLM recipe; smallest is Qwen2.5-VL-3B on 2 GPUs)
hardware: 1x GB10 (DGX Spark), 121.7 GiB unified memory shared with other services, driver 580.142
base_config: examples/configs/vlm_grpo_3B.yaml + overrides in outputs/research/grpo_probe/probe.sh (4 prompts x 4 generations, 3 steps)

probes.stopped_by: refit buffer 54 MB < embed_tokens 508 MB: free memory from cudaMemGetInfo is ~0.5 GB on UMA (page cache not counted)
vLLM: No available memory for the cache blocks (gpu_memory_utilization 0.15; profiling on a shared UMA host)

probes.reached: Step 1: 16 rollouts generated (6.5 min, eager, CPU contended by a parallel gates container) and rewards computed
probes.stopped_by: memguard MEM-002 fast-fall (host available 12.5 GB, abort 10.24 GB) during logprob/train; container peak 38.7 GB
probes.suspect: logprob over the 248k vocab not chunked (policy.logprob_chunk_size None) + a parallel 8 GB gates container
probes.next: probe 9: policy.logprob_chunk_size=256, max_total_sequence_length 1024, max_new_tokens 384, no parallel heavy container
probes.safety_note: the memory guard stopped the job before the host ran out (designed behaviour)

probes.change: policy.logprob_chunk_size=256, max_total_sequence_length 1024, max_new_tokens 384, no parallel container
probes.stopped_by: memguard MEM-002 fast-fall at 'Computing logprobs' again (host available 13.9 GB)
probes.finding: chunking was not it: memory jumps when the policy phase starts

probes.change: loss_fn.reference_policy_kl_penalty=0 (no reference model; DAPO arXiv 2503.14476, Dr.GRPO arXiv 2503.20783), TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1, LoRA use_triton false, logprob_batch_size 1, dynamic_batching mb tokens 1024
probes.root_cause: NeMo-RL loads the policy in fp32 (automodel/setup.py:330) and keeps the reference as a PINNED fp32 CPU state_dict (setup.py:432); the reference logprob pass adds a second pinned copy of the training weights (dtensor_policy_worker_v2 use_reference_model). On unified memory pinned CPU = the same RAM.
probes.result: PASS: 3 GRPO steps, exit 0, 17.1 min, checkpoint step_3 (130 MB, PEFT adapter; merge_lora OK on CPU)
caveats: reward 0 in steps 2-3: the 0.8B base solves no geometry3k problem, all-zero advantage, no learning signal
generations hit the 384-token cap (mean 362-380): a real run needs a larger max_new_tokens
LoRA targeted vision + merger + tied lm_head (NeMo-RL default match_all_linear, no exclude): the worker must pass the family's lora_exclude

status: PASS (infrastructure: 1-GPU GRPO without KL completes and checkpoints); ADR-022 DoD still needs a real run with a rising held-out reward
